subject: Compute namespace and access mismatches: Metal buffer30, write-only image, sampler flags
body: Current compute_native_dispatch review identifies three concrete mismatches to preserve in the correction pass: (1) WriteSource::Buffer rejects slot.index>=8, but slot.index is Metal index. First-v2 FAU bound applies native w.binding<8; Metal buffer30 mapped to native0 is valid. Enforce the correct namespace and test exactly that sparse case. (2) STORAGE_IMAGE match forces READ|STORAGE and requires those input bits even for a write-only image. Derive actual read/write from plan.uses/reflection; requiring SHADER_WRITE solely because STORAGE also wrongly excludes read-only storage. (3) Sampler descriptor emits flags=READ, but current pipeline2_valid_kind_flags(SAMPLER) requires all accessflags0. Freeze one agreed sampler access representation across Rust/package/wire rather than leaving a systematic refusal. Prior C/Rust flags-field mismatch is still present in air_bridge.h even though Rust size assertion was changed to10728. Missing exact image view remains visible as view:_ in both Texture and Combined matches. These are source review findings, no build or test claim.
